summary: The quest shape in twelve stages: a call away from home, a crossing into the unknown, an ordeal at the centre, and a return carrying something that changes home.
_lineage: Joseph Campbell's monomyth (1949) as storytellers commonly use it, in the twelve-stage form popularised for screenwriters by Christopher Vogler. The stage names and descriptions here are our own; _commonNames records the usual stage names, for recognition only.

beats.name: The ordinary world
beats.describe: Home as it is, and what is missing from it or from the hero.
lookFor: daily life, with a lack the hero may not see

beats.name: The call
beats.describe: A summons, a problem or a chance that points away from home.
lookFor: a message, a stranger, a disaster

beats.name: Refusal
beats.describe: Fear, duty or doubt holds the hero back, and shows what going will cost.
lookFor: the hero saying no, or not yet

beats.name: The mentor
beats.describe: Someone (or something) gives advice, a gift or the courage to go.
lookFor: a teacher, a tool, a map, a blessing

beats.name: Crossing over
beats.describe: The hero commits and passes into the unknown, where the rules are different.
lookFor: a border, a gate, a ship, a point of no return

beats.name: Trials, friends and enemies
beats.describe: The hero learns the new world's rules through tests, and finds out who is with them and who is not.

beats.name: The approach
beats.describe: The hero nears the heart of the danger and prepares, or fails to.
lookFor: a plan made before the worst place

beats.name: The ordeal
beats.describe: The central crisis: the hero faces the greatest fear yet and seems to die, literally or not.
lookFor: a confrontation where the hero could truly lose everything

beats.name: The reward
beats.describe: Surviving brings something: a prize, knowledge, a reconciliation, a new power.
lookFor: what the hero takes away from the ordeal

beats.name: The road back
beats.describe: The hero turns toward home, and the danger follows.
lookFor: a chase, a reckoning with what the ordeal set loose

beats.name: The final test
beats.describe: One last trial at the threshold, where the hero must use everything they have become.
lookFor: a climax that proves the hero has changed

beats.name: The return
beats.describe: Home again, carrying something that heals or changes it.
